email.subject: POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG) recruiting — war-focused, high donations, and we do POAP seasons
email.body:
Hey!

POAP KINGS is recruiting players who want a clan that’s organized, active, and actually keeps score on what matters.

Quick snapshot:
- Clan: POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG)
- Members: 42
- Required trophies: 2,000+
- Combined trophies: 284,907
- Avg member level: 40.5
- Weekly donations: 3,169
- Clan Wars trophies: 200

What makes us different
- We’re war-minded, but not toxic. Real life comes first; when you can play, we want you using your war decks and helping the boat.
- We build culture on purpose: POAPs (Proof of Attendance Protocol / “Proof of Arena Push”) mark seasons + meaningful clan milestones.
- We run a Free Pass Royale reward tradition for top war performance (kept rare and earned).
- We track and recap clan momentum with our own tools (including our AI helper, Elixir) so effort doesn’t disappear into the chat scroll.

A few real standouts (so you know we’re not generic):
- OllieTurtle — 13,078 trophies (often seen on Tesla + Magic Archer control)
- Vijay (Elder) — 13,000 trophies / 366 donations (Skeletons + Zap core)
- raquaza (Co-Leader) — 12,371 trophies (Mini P.E.K.K.A + Witch pressure)
- King Levy (Co-Leader) — 11,532 trophies (Ice Spirit + Musketeer fundamentals)
- Chanco (Elder) — 11,228 trophies / 350 donations (Baby Dragon + Witch)

What we’re looking for
- 2,000+ trophies minimum
- Active players who donate and show up for Clan Wars when they can
- Good vibes, low drama, and steady effort

If that sounds like your kind of clan, check us out and get the vibe here:
https://poapkings.com

— POAP KINGS
